charts.checks: marker discs found by distance-transform peaks of the non-white mask (loc2.py) and, for the three partly hidden discs (Gemini 3.5 Flash under Opus 5; Haiku 4.5 and Gemini 3.1 FL clipped by the y axis and overlapping), a fixed-radius circle fit (loc3.py); x ticks = the four tick marks under the axis, y ticks = the horizontal gridlines (4-px grey rows). Each disc is assigned to its model by colour: disc colours equal the box colours beside the model labels of panel a and the bar colours of Fig 3A. Cross-checks: the Gemini 3.1 FL disc reads $0.36 and the Gemini 3.1 Pro disc $129.2 against the text's minimum $0.35 and maximum $129.14; each disc's y reads its Fig 3A score within 0.005 (loc.json, overlay evidence/fig4b-overlay.png)
